raw_source.title: Ekvahlabs 正在招聘区块链开发人员 [CA]
raw_source.body:
# 🚀 Blockchain Developer

**Company:** EkvahLabs
**Location:** Ontario, Canada
**Timezone:** Flexible / Remote-friendly
**Website:** [[EkvahLabs](https://ekvahlabs.com/)](https://ekvahlabs.com)

## 🔗 Role Overview

EkvahLabs is looking for an experienced **Blockchain Developer** to join our engineering team and help build and maintain blockchain-based applications, Web3 products, and infrastructure.

The role focuses on developing decentralized features, blockchain integrations, smart contracts, wallet systems, transaction flows, and supporting backend infrastructure.

You’ll work with technologies such as:

* **Solidity**
* **TypeScript**
* **Node.js**
* **Ethers.js / Web3 libraries**
* **Smart Contracts**
* Blockchain APIs and infrastructure
* Wallet integrations
* NFT and Web3 technologies

## 🛠️ Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain blockchain-based applications and services
* Design, develop, test, and deploy **Solidity smart contracts**
* Build blockchain APIs and Web3 integrations
* Implement wallet connections and transaction flows
* Integrate blockchain functionality with frontend and backend systems
* Work with blockchain infrastructure and RPC providers
* Develop and maintain secure and reliable on-chain/off-chain systems
* Troubleshoot and debug complex blockchain-related issues
* Participate in technical architecture and engineering decisions
* Conduct code reviews and maintain high-quality development standards
* Improve application security, scalability, reliability, and performance
* Write automated tests for smart contracts and blockchain functionality
* Collaborate with frontend engineers, backend engineers, product teams, and other technical stakeholders

## 💡 Required Skills & Experience

* Strong professional experience in **blockchain / Web3 development**
* Strong knowledge of **Solidity and smart contract development**
* Strong **TypeScript / Node.js** experience
* Experience with **Ethers.js, Web3.js, or similar Web3 libraries**
* Experience with blockchain wallets and transaction systems
* Understanding of EVM-based blockchain networks
* Experience integrating blockchain systems with APIs and backend services
* Strong understanding of blockchain security and common smart contract vulnerabilities
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

## ⭐ Nice to Have

The following experience would be highly valuable:

* **Full-stack development experience, preferably 7+ years**
* Professional experience working with **cryptocurrency exchanges**
* Experience building or maintaining exchange-related systems, trading infrastructure, wallets, deposits/withdrawals, or transaction processing
* **Deep understanding of NFTs**, including NFT standards, marketplaces, minting, metadata, ownership, transfers, and smart contract architecture
* Experience with NFT marketplaces or NFT-based applications
* Experience with DeFi protocols and decentralized applications
* Experience with cryptocurrency payment systems
* Experience with blockchain gaming or Web3 gaming platforms
* Experience working with multiple EVM-compatible networks
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and production deployments

## 🌎 Location & Timezone

**Location:** Ontario, Canada

We are open to candidates working remotely from different locations.

**Timezone:** Flexible.

Candidates do not need to be located in the same timezone, although reasonable availability for collaboration with the engineering team is expected.

## 💰 Compensation

**9,000–12,000/month**, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

There is flexibility for exceptional candidates with significant blockchain, exchange, NFT, or full-stack experience.

## 📩 How to Apply

If you’re interested in exploring the opportunity, please provide your latest **CV or portfolio**, particularly highlighting:

* Blockchain / Web3 projects
* Solidity and smart contract experience
* Cryptocurrency exchange experience
* NFT-related projects
* Full-stack development experience
* GitHub repositories
* Wallet and transaction integrations
* Relevant production experience

After reviewing your background, we’ll follow up with the next steps.

========================================================================================

🚀 区块链开发工程师（Blockchain Developer）

公司： EkvahLabs
工作地点： 加拿大安大略省（Ontario, Canada）
时区： 灵活 / 支持远程工作
官方网站： [EkvahLabs](https://ekvahlabs.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

🔗 职位概述

EkvahLabs 正在寻找一名经验丰富的 区块链开发工程师（Blockchain Developer） 加入我们的工程团队，参与区块链应用、Web3 产品以及相关基础设施的开发与维护。

该职位主要负责去中心化功能、区块链集成、智能合约、钱包系统、链上交易流程以及相关后端基础设施的设计与开发。

你将接触并使用以下技术：

Solidity
TypeScript
Node.js
Ethers.js / Web3 Libraries
智能合约（Smart Contracts）
区块链 API 与基础设施
钱包集成
NFT 与 Web3 技术
🛠️ 工作职责
开发和维护基于区块链的应用程序及服务
设计、开发、测试并部署 Solidity 智能合约
构建区块链 API 以及 Web3 集成功能
实现钱包连接及链上交易流程
将区块链功能与前端、后端系统进行集成
使用并维护区块链基础设施及 RPC 服务
开发和维护安全、稳定可靠的链上 / 链下系统
排查和解决复杂的区块链技术问题
参与技术架构设计及工程技术决策
进行代码审查（Code Review），并持续维护高质量代码标准
持续提升系统的安全性、可扩展性、稳定性和性能
编写智能合约及区块链相关功能的自动化测试
与前端工程师、后端工程师、产品团队及其他技术团队成员密切协作
💡 任职要求
具备较强的 区块链 / Web3 开发 实际项目经验
深入掌握 Solidity 及智能合约开发
具备扎实的 TypeScript / Node.js 开发经验
熟悉 Ethers.js、Web3.js 或其他类似 Web3 开发库
具备区块链钱包及链上交易系统开发经验
理解基于 EVM（Ethereum Virtual Machine） 的区块链网络
具备区块链系统与 API、后端服务进行集成的经验
对区块链安全以及常见智能合约漏洞有深入理解
熟悉 Git 以及现代软件开发流程
具备较强的调试、问题分析和解决能力
⭐ 加分项（Nice to Have）

以下经验将作为重要加分项：

7 年以上全栈开发经验（Full-Stack Development）
具有 加密货币交易所（Cryptocurrency Exchange） 相关工作经验
具有交易所系统、交易基础设施、钱包、充值 / 提现或交易处理系统的开发及维护经验
深入理解 NFT 技术及生态，包括 NFT 标准、NFT Marketplace、Mint、Metadata、资产所有权、Transfer 以及智能合约架构等
具有 NFT Marketplace 或 NFT 应用开发经验
具有 DeFi 协议及去中心化应用（DApp）开发经验
具有加密货币支付系统开发经验
具有区块链游戏或 Web3 游戏平台开发经验
具有多个 EVM 兼容区块链网络的开发经验
具有云基础设施、CI/CD 以及生产环境部署经验
🌎 工作地点与时区

工作地点： 加拿大安大略省（Ontario, Canada）

我们支持远程工作，并欢迎来自不同地区的优秀候选人。

时区： 灵活。

候选人无需与团队处于相同的时区，但需要能够在合理的工作时间内与工程团队进行沟通和协作。

💰 薪资待遇

9,000–12,000 / 月

具体薪资将根据候选人的工作经验、技术能力以及整体匹配程度确定。

对于在区块链、加密货币交易所、NFT 或全栈开发领域拥有丰富经验的优秀候选人，我们可以提供更具竞争力的薪资待遇。

📩 如何申请

如果你对这个职位感兴趣，请提供最新的 CV / 简历或个人作品集（Portfolio），并重点介绍以下相关经验：

区块链 / Web3 项目
Solidity 及智能合约开发经验
加密货币交易所相关经验
NFT 相关项目
全栈开发经验
GitHub 开源项目或代码仓库
钱包及链上交易集成经验
相关生产环境项目经验

我们审核你的资料后，将与你进一步沟通后续流程。

🌐 关于 EkvahLabs

欢迎访问我们的官方网站，进一步了解 EkvahLabs 及我们的项目：

[ekvahlabs.com](https://ekvahlabs.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

📬 联系方式

如果你有兴趣加入我们，可以在下方评论，或者通过以下方式联系我们，并发送你的 CV / Portfolio：

Email：

[hello@ekvahlabs.com](mailto:hello@ekvahlabs.com)
[ceo@ekvahlabs.com](mailto:ceo@ekvahlabs.com)

Telegram：

@harunofurukawa

期待与你交流！ 🚀

### 🌐 About EkvahLabs

Learn more about EkvahLabs and our work:

[[ekvahlabs.com](https://ekvahlabs.com/)](https://ekvahlabs.com)

---

**Interested in joining us?**

Please comment below or reach out with your **CV / portfolio** to start the conversation via other contacts.
Email: hello@ekvahlabs.com, ceo@ekvahlabs.com
Telegram: @harunofurukawa
